notes:
Deleting a folder for good now removes its documents from search too. They used to stay findable: searching still offered them, and opening one led to a file that no longer existed. Only the folder itself was being removed from the index, never the documents inside it.

- Double-clicking a Corylus archive now opens it even when Corylus is not already running. Before, the app started, showed the home screen and did nothing with the file, because the file was handed over before the window was ready to receive it.
- If the file holding your binder structure cannot be written — a full disk, or another program holding it open — Corylus now tells you instead of appearing to save. A rename or a move could previously look applied and be gone at the next launch.
